title: Enhanced irradiation-resistance in NbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy via rhenium addition.

recollection.structure: guess: refined grain structure or improved lattice stability
recollection.mechanism: guess: enhanced diffusion, reduced defect formation, or improved atomic-scale mixing
recollection.results: guess: improved irradiation resistance, increased hardness, or enhanced thermal stability

score.note: Re addition is stated in the title. Grain refinement is a specific correct structural detail, though hedged as a guess; lattice stability was not the reported mediator. The proposed mechanism is generic and misses defect-sink grain boundaries, excess free volume, amorphous boundary regions, and suppressed He-bubble growth. No numerical results were recalled, and increased hardness is not representative of the Re-containing alloy's response.
